text_bounds.text: BUSINESS PLAN  ·  CONSUMER UNDERSTANDING & INSIGHTS
Movers feel it first: a new city, new water, and hair that no longer feels right
TARGET: ADULT “MOVERS”, 18–35

University and hall students: 4.82M in public universities and affiliated colleges (UGC, 2023)Mess residents and young workers who moved city or changed water sourceUrban and peri-urban, women and men; price-aware but brand-awareWhere: hall, mess and rented-flat bathrooms on tube-well or supply waterWant: hair that feels like home, proof rather than promises, a fair pricePhase 2: coastal households on saline water (LonaJol)
#1 = function
Women shampoo users (n=390, Dhaka and Chattogram) rank functionality first (4.21/5), above brand image (4.15) and price (4.13). Packaging comes last (3.40).
Khanam & Rahman, 2022
of coastal adults (182 of 391, Ramgati) say saline water frequently or very frequently causes hair loss, as they perceive it.
Zakaria et al., 2025
Bangladeshis live in urban areas (31.7%). The cities Movers move to are majority-flagged for iron or hardness.
BBS Census 2022; BGS/DPHE

OUR FIELD RESEARCH · 9–10 OCT 2026Google Form survey: n = [ ] consenting adultsChanged water source in the last 12 months: [ ]; of them, [ ]% felt their hair got worse[ ]% of those with a hair problem named water as a cause, unprompted[ ]% would definitely or probably buy at Tk 360Median maximum price for 340 ml: Tk [ ]Foam test: same shampoo, [ ]% less foam in hall water than in bottled water
INSIGHT   People blame their hair, or their shampoo. The real culprit may be the water, and nobody gives them a way to check.

Sources: Khanam & Rahman (2022), Journal of Social Sciences 10(12); Zakaria et al. (2025), Frontiers in Public Health; UGC Annual Report 2023 via Prothom Alo (4 Oct 2025); BBS Population & Housing Census 2022.
APPENDIX B
Evidence base, method and sensitivity

Water: BGS & DPHE (2001) National Hydrochemical Survey: 3,534 wells, 61 districts, sampled Mar 1998–Dec 1999. Team analysis: hardness = 2.497 Ca + 4.118 Mg (USGS); flags Fe >0.3 and hardness >120 mg/L. Historical wells, not today’s taps, which is why the pack carries a test.Recent water: ICCEI 2025 Dhaka tap study (12 locations with values); BWDB 2022 groundwater-quality report (901 monitoring wells, 2019–21).Consumers: Khanam & Rahman 2022 (n=390); Zakaria et al. 2025 (n=391); our Google Form survey (n=[ ]) and foam test.Hair science: Luqman 2018 (n=70: tensile strength 255 vs 234 with hard water); Srinivasan 2013 (n=15: no significant difference). Evidence is mixed, so claims wait for our own R&D tests.Market and prices: Mordor Intelligence (2026e); 24 online price observations, Chaldal and Arogga, 9 Oct 2026; Marico Bangladesh Annual Report FY2025-26.

R&D TEST PLAN   Hair-tress deposit test: at least 30% less Ca/Fe than Naturale core. Lather at least 80% of a soft-water reference at 150 and 300 mg/L. Home-use test n≈100. Stability at 40°C / 75% RH.
Biggest levers: cannibalisation and COGS. Both are measured in the pilot before any national spend.
Hair-science references: Luqman et al. 2018 (PMID 30034190); Srinivasan et al. 2013 (PMID 24574692). Sensitivities from finance_v4.cjs.

OUR CONSUMER SURVEY · 3–9 OCT 202649 consenting adults from 50 Google Form submissions18 of 22 water-source changers reported worse hair problems (81.8%)38 of 49 rated the concept 4 or 5 out of 5 (77.6%)Median maximum price for 340 ml: Tk 320 (n=47)15 of 47 stated a maximum price of at least Tk 360 (31.9%)Convenience sample; self-reports. Water/foam tests remain planned.

BIG BRANDS SEE THE NEEDUnilever launched Dove Hard Water Defense in the Gulf, built on “Mineral Shield” technology against calcium deposits.NEXT: OUR CONSUMER TESTBefore the pilot: an adult survey of Movers (hair change after a water change, unprompted cause, open price before Tk 360) and a same-shampoo foam test in hall water. Results are reported with their real sample sizes.
